decision: Plan framing: operator asked why the dashboard is passive — why not guide an agentic operator to run the safe repairs and resolve issues across tabs automatically, stopping the human only for creds/spend/destructive/external-approval. Recast as a safe-repair orchestration layer ON TOP of 001 (resolution_class + clears_when round-trip), 004 (freshness), and 005 (render/scope truth) — not new resolution logic. Critical assessment: ~60% reuses existing primitives (resolution_class ~= the four-way action class; clears_when ~= round-trip verification; 005 render gate ~= what is genuinely unresolved). The genuinely-new pieces: a SAFETY taxonomy distinct from resolvability (a command_resolvable action can still be destructive), a dependency-ordered fixpoint planner, the agent-handoff bundle, and apply-time verification wiring.

Execution model (operator decision): THREE TIERS, default emit-only, to respect DontPanic's no-mutation boundary (the project-selector objective_contract explicitly forbids dashboard mutation of plan/registry state; the architecture memo keeps DontPanic=governs / runtime=executes). Tier 1 `repair plan` = emit-only JSON bundle, no mutation (default). Tier 2 `repair apply --safe-derived-state` = execute ONLY apply_tier=derived_state (regenerate derived/cached projection: rebuild state, recompute what-now, refresh capability status, refresh reconcile CHECK, regen architecture if bounded, clear replaceable generated caches, re-export, suppress resolved). Tier 3 `repair apply --safe --confirm` = additionally execute an explicit allowlist of apply_tier=confirmed_local mutations. NO tier runs deploy/creds/paid-dispatch/role-change/plan-state/registry/destructive/reconcile-baseline (human_required unless explicitly approved). Every executing tier requires per-command safety_class + clears_when + round-trip verification. Rationale: most operator pain is stale derived state, so the derived_state tier solves much without turning DontPanic into an uncontrolled actor.

Safety is PRODUCER-ASSERTED, never runner-inferred (same fail-closed discipline as 005's scope): the emitter declares safety_class + apply_tier; the runner validates against the policy and defaults anything unclassified/policy-failing to human_required. safety_class (whether it may auto-run) is orthogonal to 001's resolution_class (how it resolves). Sequenced AFTER 005 (depends on the truthful render gate + scope + resolution_class). status: draft, pre_impl is the human gate.

Built F005 (round-trip verification) then F002 (fixpoint planner), pure modules, red/green TDD, per D004 build order. F005 repair_verify.verify_round_trip reuses 001's evaluate_clears_when at apply time -> {cleared, chained, human_required, unchanged}; unchanged is the defect signal (a command action whose predicate did not move). F002 repair_planner: RepairAction dataclass (safety assertion + 001 resolvability + depends_on + F003 bundle display fields), order_actions (Kahn topo sort + cycle detection), run_fixpoint (apply eligible auto_safe batch -> recompute via injected apply_fn -> re-plan, structural termination since applied actions are never retried). Deferral reasons: safety_tier / dependency / cycle. select_candidates consumes the 005 render gate (render+demote kept, suppress skipped). is_runnable_at (F001) gates the per-tier eligibility so confirmed_local stays out of --safe-derived-state. 8 F005 + 10 F002 tests green; full orchestrate sweep 3887 passed, 7 skipped (was 3869 at F001). Next per D004: F003 emit-only bundle CLI.

Built F003 (emit-only agent-handoff bundle). repair_bundle.build_bundle is PURE: order_actions -> resolve_safety per action -> emit {scope, actions[6-field contract + id/resolution_class/depends_on], deferred[cycle]}. The emitted safety_class is the EFFECTIVE value from resolve_safety, so an unclassified/forbidden action is reported human_required (fail closed, D003) — the bundle never overstates what may auto-run. action_to_repair_action adapts a live ActionItem reading PRODUCER-ASSERTED safety via attrs (safety_class/apply_tier/repair_kind/depends_on); legacy items with no safety fields -> None -> human_required. CLI `dontpanic repair plan [--scope S] [--format json|text]` wired in cli.py (_repair_main) + main() dispatch + top-level help; it sources cards via new dashboard.gather_action_items_readonly (mirrors build()'s capabilities/reconcile/architecture/gate loaders but writes NO cache — emit path must never mutate). --plans-root/--repo-root override for deterministic tests. 13 F003 tests green (bundle snapshot/ordering/fail-closed/no-input-mutation + CLI emits-json-mutates-nothing/usage-error/text-format); full orchestrate sweep 3900 passed, 7 skipped (was 3887). NOTE: existing ActionItem producers do not yet assert safety_class, so live `repair plan` currently classifies every card human_required by fail-closed default — honest, and the producer-side safety assertions land with F004/F006 wiring. Next per D004: F004 tiered apply CLI.

Built F004 (tiered opt-in local apply). repair_apply.apply_repairs runs the F002 fixpoint with an injected real effect_fn + recompute_fn: per eligible auto_safe action it executes the effect, recomputes live_state, and round-trip verifies (F005). Tier gating via is_runnable_at (--safe-derived-state -> RUN_TIER_DERIVED runs only derived_state; --safe --confirm -> RUN_TIER_CONFIRM adds confirmed_local). Three safety properties, all tested: (1) execution-time forbidden-kind guard (new repair_safety.is_forbidden_kind) REFUSES any FORBIDDEN_KINDS action that mis-asserted auto_safe, regardless of flag, surfaced in report.refused; (2) effect_fn exception is caught -> ApplyRefusal(execution_failed) + run CONTINUES (one bad effect never aborts the batch); (3) unclassified action never executes (human_required -> not runnable -> deferred safety). ApplyReport = applied(ApplyStep w/ F005 outcome) + refused(forbidden_kind/execution_failed) + deferred(safety/dependency/cycle). CLI `dontpanic repair apply --safe-derived-state | --safe --confirm` in cli.py (_repair_main split into _repair_plan_cmd/_repair_apply_cmd); --safe without --confirm and no-tier-flag both exit 2 with guidance. Effect dispatch: derived_state kinds -> dashboard.build (the single idempotent projection regen); confirmed_local effects raise NotImplementedError -> honest execution_failed until producers assert them.
